Upper Text: [Main] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [Tyrannomon] in its name or the [Reptile] or [Dinosaur] trait and 1 [LIBERATOR] trait card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Your Turn] When any of your [Ryutaro Williams]es are played, ＜Delay＞.
・1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a level 6 or lower [LIBERATOR] trait card in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 3.
